# Atanu Ghosh - Portfolio

Welcome to the LLM agent directory for Atanu Ghosh's portfolio website. I am a Full Stack Developer and Electrical Engineer.

## Important Links
- [Main Website](https://www.buildwithatanu.in/)
- [Portfolio & Projects](https://www.buildwithatanu.in/portfolio)
- [Sitemap](https://www.buildwithatanu.in/sitemap.xml)

## Technical Stack
This website is built using React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Three.js on the frontend, with a Node.js and MongoDB backend.
